library.about: Neon Drift Arena's production art for the Factory's golden 3D run, mapped by the role each asset_requirement of the arena-dodge archetype carries (player, threat, environment, icon, font) and by id for the wordmark. Models are GLBs the Factory's pinned Blender 4.5.14 built from the model specs beside them (models/*.model.json; build-models.sh rebuilds and inspects them). Read by the assets step through factory.assets.libraries. The music and sound effects (audio/) are composed as code (tools/audio-score.js) and rendered by examples/wgf-golden-shared/library/tools/audio/render.mjs, CC0-1.0; where a cue layers a recording it is a CC0-1.0 Kenney sample kept beside it in audio/sources/ with its licence. audio/render-report.json holds each file's measured duration, RMS, peak and loop seam.
